query: Every obcmd command I run returns 403 even though my token works in the UI.
note: Symptom phrasing, and the case most often misread as a permissions wall when it is an account-context mismatch.

query: Our Google Ads credential in Openbridge was revoked and the feed died. How do I reconnect it?
note: Collision guard. A revoked third-party credential is a remote identity, not the caller's own obcmd token. Both are 'authentication' in plain English, which is exactly why this case exists.
